    n = len(grid)
    m = len(grid[0])

    info = []

def transform(grid):
    bg = grid[0][0]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg}
    objects = []
    for c in colors:
        cells = [(r, j) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == c]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, j in cells), max(r for r, j in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(j for r, j in cells), max(j for r, j in cells)
        holes = {(r, j) for r in range(r0, r1 + 1) for j in range(c0, c1 + 1) if grid[r][j] == bg}
        components = []
        while holes:
            stack = [holes.pop()]
            comp = []
            while stack:
                p = stack.pop()
                comp.append(p)
                r, j = p
                for q in ((r-1,j),(r+1,j),(r,j-1),(r,j+1)):
                    if q in holes:
                        holes.remove(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            components.append(comp)
        area = (r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
        objects.append({'color':c,'box':(r0,r1,c0,c1),'components':components,'area':area,'cells':cells})
    pattern = min((o for o in objects if len(o['components']) == 2), key=lambda o:o['area'])
    fillers = [o for o in objects if not o['components']]
    fillers.sort(key=lambda o: sum(r for r,j in o['cells'])/len(o['cells']))
    components = sorted(pattern['components'], key=lambda comp:(min(r for r,j in comp),min(j for r,j in comp)))
    result = [[pattern['color'] if grid[r][j] == pattern['color'] else bg for j in range(pattern['box'][2],pattern['box'][3]+1)] for r in range(pattern['box'][0],pattern['box'][1]+1)]
    r0,c0 = pattern['box'][0],pattern['box'][2]
    for i,comp in enumerate(components):
        f = fillers[min(i,len(fillers)-1)]
        for r,j in comp:
            result[r-r0][j-c0] = f['color']
    return result

def transform(grid):
    bg = grid[0][0]
    objects = []
    for c in {v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg}:
        cells = [(r,j) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v == c]
        r0,r1 = min(r for r,j in cells),max(r for r,j in cells)
        c0,c1 = min(j for r,j in cells),max(j for r,j in cells)
        holes = [(r,j) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1) if grid[r][j] == bg]
        objects.append((c,r0,r1,c0,c1,cells,holes))
    pattern = min((o for o in objects if len(o[6]) == 2),key=lambda o:(o[2]-o[1]+1)*(o[4]-o[3]+1))
    c,r0,r1,c0,c1,cells,holes = pattern
    pr,pc = (r0+r1)/2,(c0+c1)/2
    hr = sum(r for r,j in holes)/len(holes)
    if hr < pr:
        markers = [o for o in objects if not o[6] and sum(r for r,j in o[5])/len(o[5]) < pr]
    else:
        markers = [o for o in objects if not o[6] and sum(r for r,j in o[5])/len(o[5]) > pr]
    marker = min(markers,key=lambda o:(sum(r for r,j in o[5])/len(o[5])-pr)**2+(sum(j for r,j in o[5])/len(o[5])-pc)**2)
    return [[c if grid[r][j] == c else marker[0] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
